name: nuxt-module
description: Weburz-flavored Nuxt 4 module starter. @nuxt/module-builder + runtime component + playground + vitest e2e fixture, eslint flat config, MIT, GitHub Actions QA + Pages deploy.

variables.name: CodeOwner
variables.prompt: GitHub user for CODEOWNERS and Dependabot assignee (without @)

variables.name: ComponentName
variables.prompt: Auto-imported runtime component name (PascalCase, e.g. HelloWorld)

variables.name: ConfigKey
variables.prompt: nuxt.config key consumers use for module options (camelCase, e.g. myModule)
